headlines.title: What Ross Stores Shares Full Year Guidance Raise Means For Shareholders
headlines.summary: Ross Stores reported quarterly and nine month results with sales of US$6.26b and US$18.53b, alongside higher net income and earnings per share versus the prior year periods. The company also raised full year and fourth quarter 2026 earnings guidance, affirmed a regular cash dividend, and updated progress on its share repurchase program. Management paired stronger profitability metrics with a higher earnings outlook and continued capital returns.

headlines.title: Ross Stores (ROST) Could Be 199% Above Fair Value As Guidance Rises
headlines.summary: Ross Stores (ROST) is back in focus after reporting third quarter results that showed higher sales, stronger net income, and firmer earnings per share, paired with raised full year and fourth quarter guidance. Despite the upbeat third quarter and higher guidance, Ross Stores shares have eased in the short term, with the 30-day share price return down 4.63% and the 7-day return down 1.92%. However, the year-to-date share price return is up 22.

headlines.title: Why Is Ross Stores (ROST) Stock Up Today? Burlington Earnings Lift Off-Price Rivals
headlines.summary: On Tuesday, Nov. 24, Ross Stores rose 4.1% as off-price rival Burlington jumped after its Q3 earnings, while the S&P 500 fell 1.0%.

headlines.title: Bargain Hunting: Why Off-Price Retail Is Winning
headlines.summary: TJX and Ross Stores posted strong quarterly revenue amid freight-cost margin pressure, as investors now turn to Burlington Stores' Nov. 24 earnings to gauge off-price retail valuations.

description: Ross Stores, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates off-price retail apparel and home fashion stores under the Ross Dress for Less and dd's DISCOUNTS brands in the United States. The company offers designer apparel, accessories, footwear, and home-fashioned products for the entire family. It sells its products to middle income households and households with lower to more moderate incomes. Ross Stores, Inc. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Dublin, California.
